meaning.en: Of or relating to a church, especially as an organized institution.

meaning.en: Used chiefly in early writings relating to Christianity.
meaning.vi: Được sử dụng chủ yếu trong các tác phẩm đầu tiên liên quan đến Cơ đốc giáo.

meaning.en: Appropriate to a church or to use in a church.
meaning.vi: Thích hợp cho nhà thờ hoặc sử dụng trong nhà thờ.

meaning.en: The definition of ecclesiastical is something derived from or related to the Christian church.

sentences.en: That principle is Spiritual in- equally opposed to Erastianism and to Papacy, to the civil power dominating the Church, and to the ecclesiastical power dominating the state.

sentences.en: He was content that ecclesiastical supremacy should be with the civil power, and he believed that the work of the Reformation would in that way be best preserved and furthered.

sentences.en: The state retained control of the ecclesiastical organization, and Calvin secured his much-needed system of discipline.

sentences.en: Their ecclesiastical polity came much more from Paris than from Geneva."2 To trace the history of Presbyterianism in France for the next thirty years would be to write the history of France itself during that period.

sentences.en: The state controls all ecclesiastical appointments, decides on the passing or rejection of all decrees of the Holy See, and provides an annual subsidy for maintenance of the churches and clergy.
sentences.vi: Nhà nước kiểm soát tất cả các cuộc bổ nhiệm của giáo hội, quyết định việc thông qua hoặc từ chối tất cả các sắc lệnh của Tòa thánh, và cung cấp một khoản trợ cấp hàng năm để bảo trì các nhà thờ và giáo sĩ.
